result.stdout:
Run custom matting and validate its mask result when waiting.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --ref TEXT          Unified draft reference
          --seg-id TEXT REQUIRED 
                              Target video segment id (raw id, no seg_id= prefix)
          --feather TEXT      Matting edge feather, e.g. 10
          --expansion TEXT    Matting edge expansion, e.g. 5
          --reverse           Reverse the algorithm effect where supported
          --wait TEXT         Wait for a terminal custom-matting result and validate a mask
                              artifact created or updated by this invocation (standalone CLI
                              enforces terminal waiting; default true)
          --timeout <duration> 
                              Execution timeout; explicit unit required, e.g. 5min or 300s
          --disable           Disable custom matting on the target segment without running a
                              task
          --workspace TEXT    Matting output directory (alias of `path`)
          --config-path TEXT  Override the algorithm config directory
          --mask-video-path TEXT 
                              Existing custom-matting mask video path to write or reuse
          --custom-matting-id TEXT 
                              Custom matting id; reuses old value or a UUID when omitted
          --matting-tag TEXT  Custom matting tag
          --blend-mode TEXT   Mask blend / preview mode: normal / preview / hide
          --blend-color TEXT  Blend / preview color
          --interactive-time <microseconds> 
                              Brush interaction time in whole microseconds; accepts 1000000 or
                              1000000us (required to trigger a task)
          --brush-type TEXT   Brush type: fast / general / eraser / fasteraser
          --brush-size TEXT   Brush size in pixels
          --brush-size-relative TEXT 
                              Relative brush thickness (normalized to relative_thickness)
          --brush-points TEXT Precise brush points, normalized `x1,y1,x2,y2,...`
          --brush-shape TEXT  Quick region shape: rect / ellipse / circle / center / line /
                              full (mutually exclusive with --brush-points)
          --rect TEXT         Normalized coords for --brush-shape rect: x,y,w,h
          --ellipse TEXT      Normalized coords for --brush-shape ellipse
          --circle TEXT       Normalized coords for --brush-shape circle
          --center TEXT       Normalized coords for --brush-shape center
          --line TEXT         Normalized coords for --brush-shape line
          --cloud-product-fps TEXT 
                              Cloud product fps, numeric
          --ai-smart-matting TEXT 
                              Overlay cloud AI matting: true / false
          --use-quick-brush TEXT 
                              Quick-brush usage flag: true / false
          --has-use-quick-eraser TEXT 
                              Quick-eraser usage flag: true / false
          --run-task          Explicitly trigger the custom-matting task (still requires
                              brush/shape and --interactive-time)
          --commit-immediately 
                              Commit the interactive task immediately
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  # Run custom matting with an explicit brush stroke
  $ lyra-cli draft algo custom-matting --seg-id <UUID> --interactive-time 0us \
      --brush-type general --brush-size 30 --brush-points "0.1,0.1,0.2,0.2" --run-task --wait true
  # Run custom matting with a quick region shape
  $ lyra-cli draft algo custom-matting --seg-id <UUID> --interactive-time 0us \
      --brush-shape rect --rect "0.1,0.1,0.4,0.4" --run-task --wait true
  # Reuse an existing mask video, or invert the matte
  $ lyra-cli draft algo custom-matting --seg-id <UUID> --mask-video-path /tmp/mask.mp4
  $ lyra-cli draft algo custom-matting --seg-id <UUID> --reverse
  $ lyra-cli draft algo custom-matting --seg-id <UUID> --disable

RESULT CONTRACT
  --wait true: err_code=0 only after this invocation creates or updates a usable mask artifact; err_code=0 only after a usable mask artifact is verified.
  Unchanged historical artifacts do not count.
  The command does not expose submission-only success.
  A terminal algorithm failure returns a non-zero command err_code; the error detail embedded in err_msg retains lyra_err_code and lyra_err_msg.
  The standalone CLI enforces terminal waiting even when --wait false is passed; embedded run-task calls also reject wait=false until a queryable task handle exists.
